rules.statement: Each new verb has twelve explicit indicative cells, not just diagnostic principal parts. Present plurals share one form; preterite plurals share one form. Weak2sg past adds -st to the selected past1sg; strong2sg past takes the plural stem plus -e.

Cīepan takes -pte, āfēdan and selected weak rǣdan -dde; gestillan loses one l before -de; ālīehtan takes -hte with the two t sounds contracted. Bycgan/sēcan must learn bohte/sōhte. Fręmman retains doubled mm in most present forms but has fręmest/fręmeð and fręmede.

Select uncontracted present ālīehtest/ālīehteð to show the ending after the ht cluster. Present1sg ālīehte and past1/3sg ālīehte coincide; present2sg ālīehtest and past2sg ālīehtest coincide. No invented distinction from vowel length.

Rōwan changes ō→ē only in present2/3sg and has rēow past; blāwan ā→ǣ and blēow; bēatan ēa→īe and bēot; forlǣtan has forlēt; āstīgan has āstāg/āstige/āstigon. Final d/t + ð yields tt; g before st/ð yields h.
Prefixed begān follows gān throughout: begā/begǣst/begǣð/begāð; beēode/beēodest/beēodon. The prefix does not make the verb weak.
Wician, ðolian and gegaderian follow prior weakII: -ie/-ast/-að/-iað and -ode/-odest/-odon. Full new cells are displayed, though the class rules are prior.

Selected singular commands are rōw, byge, sēc, begā, gestil, rǣd; plural commands are the respective presentplural forms. Sēcan subjunctive uses sēce/sēcen and sōhte/sōhten. Source sēceað is preserved.

Full indicative display teaches indicative morphology only. Only six command pairs and the sēcan subjunctive are added. New citation infinitives are supplied except productive wician; source-only fēt, geðūht, gerǣd, tōgēiecte and libbende gesceafta remain locally supported. No systematic perfect, progressive, impersonal, infinitive tense or advanced sequence-of-tenses system follows.

Rǣdan is classified as usually weak in Cook§110 and explicitly as113 in his vocabulary: select rǣdde/rǣddon. Strong rēd/rēdon is a valid alternative system, not an independently required recall target.

Keep Cook hooked ę and macrons; selected bycgan/sēcan omit optional e before a vowel as Cook permits. BT bygeþ→bygeð is declared dental-letter normalization, with all quantities checked against Cook. Complete derived tables are new teaching material, not quoted historical paradigms.
